long_biography.plain_text:
Investor Pavel Sukhoruchkin worked with Heesen's management for more than a decade as the Dutch builder developed from a family business into an international shipyard. He and fellow supervisory-board member Pavel Novoselov stepped down in 2022, when chief executive Arthur Brouwer publicly acknowledged their contribution.

In Monaco, Sukhoruchkin and Marina Kulishova established GIIS Monaco in 2016, with both shareholders serving as managers. The consultancy was formed to advise businesses on their organisation, strategy and communications. Its intended client base extended beyond the principality, while its remit expressly excluded legal advice and regulated financial services.
